newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air Afrique Brazzaville cargo service open.
newsitem.headline: Air Afrique Brazzaville cargo service open.

text.p: Air Afrique said early Monday afternoon it was continuing to take cargo bookings on the airline's ex-Paris passenger services to the Congolese capital of Brazzaville despite political unrest in the West African state.
"As we speak, we are still accepting freight but clearly the situation could change at any moment," an Air Afrique cargo official told Reuters.

The official added the Pan-African carrier was operating one of a normal schedule of two weekly Airbus 320 services to Brazzaville from Paris. The next flight leaves Paris at 23.45 (21.45 GMT) Tuesday.
An Air France Cargo official said it was not taking bookings until further notice following the suspension of its four-times weekly Paris-Brazzville passenger service.
The French national airline operates Airbus 340 and 310 aircraft on the route.
